scripts.build: npm run build -w @cairnjs/core && npm run build -w @cairnjs/plugin-example && npm run build -w @cairnjs/plugin-auth
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run dev -w @cairnjs/basic-api
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @cairnjs/basic-api
